content:
The batch review result reports new lot and quota identifiers and the actual source records. Later batch_release changes availability on its original lot_ids.

Evidence for a different sample or month does not release this batch. A submitted review does not credit cash.

Source-specific conversion and recipient-channel rules continue to apply after review. Each conversion settles in 10 minutes and a subsequent bank withdrawal in another 10 minutes.

A customer deadline applies to actual recipient settlement.
